COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
S.A. No. 74 of 2012
Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Present Mr. Anil Kumar Joshi, counsel for the 
appellants.
No representation for the respondent.
2. A Delay Condonation Application (IA 7294 of 
2023) has been filed by the appellant along with 
affidavit of the appellant.
3. Cause shown is found sufficient. The delay is 
condoned. Delay Condonation Application (IA 7294 
of 2023) would stand allowed.
4. The application for Setting Aside Abatement 
(IA 7296 of 2023) has been filed by the appellant to 
set aside the abetment against respondent no.1, the 
same is allowed. 
5. Substitution Application (IA 7295 of 2023) has 
been filed by the appellant with the prayer that 
respondent no.1/Devraj Singh Bisht has died on 
05.02.2023, therefore, he may be permitted to 
substitute his legal heirs on record.
6. For the reasons stated, the Substitution 
Application is allowed.
7. Let amended memo of parties be filed within 
one week.
8. Put up on 15.12.2023. 
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) 19.09.2023 Mamta
